filesystem.notes: WSL2 paths for CLI use. LibreChat uses /app/* container paths instead.

spotify.notes: Managed via LibreChat .env. Goose would need separate token wiring.

github-buildstate.notes: Official hosted GitHub MCP. Explicit read-only mode. Repository-only toolset (X-MCP-Toolsets: repos). Static PAT auth (requiresOAuth: false) via GITHUB_MCP_PAT pointer in ~/LibreChat/.env (value never stored here). Local Git through WSL2 remains the only approved write/push route.
